fields.why: Fair/poor health percentages are compared across 3 age groups and across 3 FPL income groups within each age group.
Each margin (income, age) is compared within levels of the other, so two entries, not one 9-cell entry (rule F3).
QuickStats with error-bar CIs only; no test or overlap rule is stated behind 'increased with age' or 'decreased with increasing incomes'.
